---

Before filing, two places worth a glance - no problem if you skip them:

- [The plan](https://github.com/SathishKumarAI/pb-card-deck#the-plan) - what is
  already considered, and why it is not there yet.
- [`docs/BACKLOG.md`](https://github.com/SathishKumarAI/pb-card-deck/blob/main/docs/BACKLOG.md) -
  557 catalogued ideas. If yours is there, say so and that it matters to you;
  that is what moves a row up.

**Note:** this app is deliberately local-first - no accounts, no server, no
tracking. Ideas that need a backend are still welcome, but the answer may be a
peer-to-peer or share-code version of the same thing.
